title: Return to Athos with a month-long visa via the CIA Athens chief; Saint Anne's skete

tellings.quote: I still had all my contacts and friends at CIA, including the guy who was head of our office in Athens, right? And uh I lined it up with him.

plain: In 2005, Ralph Larson, a former CIA officer, says he went back to Mount Athos, a mountain in Greece home to Orthodox monasteries, with a month-long permit to stay, which he arranged through the head of the CIA's office in Athens, an old friend he does not name. He tells it first-hand, as part of a trip that took him to Saint Anne's skete, a small community of monks on the mountain.
